notes.title: New version coming soon
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10292247/42b9350bba9c0e6c222782dceab8d307f8eaf7c7.jpg

Hello,
Firstly I would like to inform you that our studio has changed, Eplixe is now Thorngames, can follow our work by registering your email on the site: http://thorngames.com/

Finally I have some news about the new version of Lost Moon!
We completely change the technology, the game will have changes in game design, level design, among others.
We are working to release a version by the end of the year.
As soon I have news I'll post.
Here a video with the new intro of the game.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OIMnsMcuQ0E

notes.title: Changes
notes.notes:
Listening the requests i will have to adjust the release date due to changes in game design such as, adjust collisions, rethinking oxygen system, balance the difficult, remove the Adobe Air installation, add new elements and work more on the story.

We want to create a great game, so we will make all the necessary changes to it.

If you have more suggestions let in the comments or discussion.

Thanks
